name: store_byte_through_pointer

name: divide_32bit_with_remainder

name: multiply_32bit_integers

name: negate_result_on_flag

name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit, then allocates and initialises a message port structure with its type, signal bit and task fields set. If the memory allocation fails, it frees the signal bit and returns zero.

name: delete_message_port
description: Removes a message port from its list when a linked field is set, marks its type and signal fields as deleted, frees the signal bit and releases the port's memory block.

name: find_pattern_in_text
description: Searches a null-terminated text for a non-empty pattern string by comparing the pattern at each starting position. Returns one when the pattern is found and zero otherwise, and skips the search when the text starts with a newline.

name: initialise_list_header
description: Sets up an empty list header in the given block: the first pointer refers to the field after it, the middle field is cleared, and the last pointer refers back to the header itself.

name: parse_command_line_and_run
description: Program entry point. It allocates a control block, splits the command-line text into words with quote and star-escape handling, opens the DOS library and needed exec resources, runs the main body, and raises an exec alert if setup fails.

name: cleanup_program_and_reply
description: Stores a result code in the control block, then closes the open file handle when present, frees the memory block, closes the library and replies to the owning message. Returns the stored result code.

name: allocate_memory_block

name: invoke_task_switch
description: Calls the exec task-switch function through the stored library base, which lets other ready tasks run.

name: forbid_multitasking
description: Calls the exec Forbid function through the stored library base, which stops task switching until multitasking is permitted again.

name: dispatch_task_queue
description: Calls the exec dispatch function through the stored library base, which selects the next task from the ready queue to run.

name: schedule_next_task
description: Calls the exec scheduler through the stored library base to choose the next ready task to run.

name: allocate_absolute_memory

name: reschedule_tasks

name: free_format_buffers
description: Frees each of several format buffers that are still allocated, using their recorded sizes and clearing their pointers, then calls a final routine with the given argument.

name: translate_disk_error_code
description: Runs a disk operation, retrying while the device reports one specific busy code, then classifies the returned error code and displays the matching message text. The classified code is returned to the caller.

name: report_format_status_message
description: Selects one of the format-related messages depending on a flag, displays it, and returns the status code it was given. The messages cover write protection, a missing disk and a failed format.

name: match_byte_in_table
description: Scans an eight-entry byte table for the given value and records the matching entry in a field of a structure returned by a routine call. Returns the value that was passed in.

name: find_drive_entry

name: measure_cstring_length

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer

name: convert_char_to_uppercase
description: Returns the character in upper case when it is a lowercase letter from a to z, and returns any other character unchanged.

name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings one character at a time after passing each character through a case conversion routine. Returns one when they match and zero otherwise.

name: terminate_string_at_colon
description: Advances through a string until it reaches a colon or the end, then writes a zero byte at that position so the string is cut at its first colon.

name: check_single_argument_result

description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one when the first sorts before the second, one when it sorts after, and zero when they are equal.

name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Walks a table of entries, allocating a small node for each one, storing a value from the entry in the node, and chaining the nodes together. It returns the head of the new chain, or the nodes built so far when an allocation or lookup fails.

name: forbid_multitasking
description: Calls the exec Forbid function through the stored library base, which stops task switching until multitasking is permitted again.

name: permit_multitasking
description: Calls the exec Permit function through the stored library base, which re-enables task switching after a matching Forbid call.

name: check_workbench_release_string
description: Handles a version text buffer: when a fixed character position holds a two, it writes a dot-padding field after the version, and otherwise it compares the buffer with the fixed release text and stops at the first mismatch.

name: write_version_padding
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into a fixed field of the buffer it is given.

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer

name: stub_empty_routine

name: forward_call_with_stack_slot

name: call_hook_then_measure_string
description: Calls a function pointer loaded from a global table, then counts the characters of a stack buffer up to its terminating zero byte. If the count is non-zero it passes the buffer and the count on to another routine.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory location held in the address register, then returns. It is a single byte store with no other effects.

name: run_version_command

name: cleanup_program_and_reply

name: check_library_version

name: call_fixed_code_then_forward
